_comment: Debrief talking points (engine/talking-points.js): plain-language discussion prompts built from a group's flags, timeliness, priorities (the priority-mismatch flag), delegation, penalties and the cases' should-recognize items. {patient} = "(C1) Robert Miller", {message} = the flag's own text, {label}, {minutes}, {student}, {item}. Themes order the list. All wording is a draft for the instructor (SPEC §14).

priority-mismatch.text: {patient}: {message} Ask how they ranked this patient and what would have changed it.

tier-timeout.text: {patient}: {message} Ask what was competing for their time.

call-light-response.text: {patient}: {message} Ask what they were doing when the light came on.

alarm-response.text: {patient}: {message} Ask how they decided whether the alarm was real.

parameter-breach.text: {patient}: {message} Ask when they noticed the change and how they would phrase the call (SBAR).

inappropriate-delegation.text: {patient}: {message} Ask what made this task delegable or not.

delegation-overload.text: {message} Ask how they decided what to keep and what to hand off.

left-unattended.text: {patient}: {message} Ask what told them it was safe to step away.

prn-limit.text: {patient}: {message} Ask what they checked before giving it.

allergy-conflict.text: {patient}: {message} Ask where they look for allergies before giving a medication.

assessment-mismatch.text: {patient}: {message} Ask what they saw that led to their score.

assessment-overdue.text: {patient}: {message} Ask how they keep track of reassessments.

required-assessment-missing.text: {patient}: {message} Ask why this assessment matters for this patient.

timeliness.veryLate: {patient}: "{label}" was done {minutes} min late. Ask what was competing for their time.
timeliness.never: {patient}: "{label}" was never done. Ask whether they saw it and what got in the way.

delegationWait.text: {patient}: "{label}" waited {minutes} min for a helper. Ask whether doing it themselves would have been faster.

penalty.text: {patient} lost ground ({label}). Ask when they first noticed the change and what they did.

shouldRecognize.text: {patient}: {item} Ask whether they saw this, and when.
shouldRecognize._comment: skipIfMentioned: 'all' = skip the point when every student in the group who wrote a reflection mentions it (keyword match, a reading aid); 'any' = when at least one does; 'off' = always show. Skipped points stay one click away ("Show … already in reflections").
